note: The owned states of the map in the mod (history/states), each given to its realm, with the realm's capital resolved through the realm's capital point of the create_world call. Ids renumber whenever the map is written: regenerate this file after any map write. Unowned states carry no entry (`unowned`).

Y7V.reason: The Lustras Hills of the krors lie south of the Herrodon Mountains (magical_lands.md 2); Herrodon borders both of the old Sacomananos states and holds the wild hills on the map.

Y7Y.reason: The Lost Lands are the empty shore under the Herrodon rim (magical_lands.md 7 and 11); Eldafaen borders five of the old Filion states, through its capital, and holds the empty coast on the map.

Y3O.reason: The Cursed Square is a reef where islanders live on wrecks, held on the map by Benan (tritons_islands.md 11).
